name.description: display name; also the glTF scene name

notes.description: free text: intent, constraints, what to keep

palette.description: named colors parts refer to — recolor a model by editing one entry

style.description: a style sheet (path to a .style.json, or inline) shared across a pack: palette, material defaults, settings, height ranges

palette.description: the pack's colors; scenes use these keys

blend.description: blend for parts that do not set one

rounding.description: edge rounding for boxes, cylinders, cones and prisms that do not set one

heights.description: allowed height range in meters per category, e.g. { "character": [1.0, 1.4] }

category.description: what this is in the pack (character, prop, building …); the style checks its height

resolution.description: cells along the longest axis (detail vs. triangles), default 96

ground.description: auto lifts/drops the model so it stands on y=0 (default)

symmetry.description: declare mirror symmetry so critics check it

screenHeight.description: how tall the model appears in the game, in pixels; critics flag details a player cannot see at that size

ao.description: compute ambient occlusion into vertex shading (default true)

edges.description: soft (default) rounds edges to the cell size, good for organic shapes; sharp keeps real corners and edges (crates, blades, buildings, robots)

rig.description: auto: skeleton from parts when clips exist

id.description: unique snake_case id; a mirror twin is id + ".m" (exported to glTF as id_mirror)

role.description: semantic role used by animation and critics: body, head, leg, arm, tail, wing, wheel, rotor, eye, ear, horn, prop …

length.description: total length along local Y including both caps

sides.description: faceted: 6 = hexagonal prism (crystals, pencils, tiles); default round

height.description: along local Y, base at the bottom

sides.description: faceted: 4 = pyramid, 6 = crystal point; default round

radius.description: ring radius, ring lies in the local XZ plane

size.description: triangular cross-section in XY (peak on top), extruded along Z — roofs, blades

src.description: path to a .glb or .obj (absolute, or relative to where the server runs / the workspace)

size.description: scale so the longest axis is this many meters; default keeps the file's units

resolution.description: distance grid cells on the longest axis (default 64)

keep.description: keep the file's own triangles (fine and sharp detail survives) instead of rebuilding it from the distance grid; it is then always a separate mesh

size.description: width (local X) and height (local Y); the sheet faces +Z

thickness.description: meters (default 0.004): leaves, paper, cloth, flags, sails, cards

bend.description: total curl in degrees along its height, toward +Z (negative: toward -Z)

wave.description: ripples across its width, like a flag or a curtain

profile.description: [radius, height] points from bottom to top, spun around local Y — vases, bottles, columns, lamp shades, chess pieces

sides.description: faceted around Y (6 = hexagonal); default round

smooth.description: run a smooth curve through the points instead of straight segments

shell.description: wall thickness: an open-topped wall along the profile instead of a solid — cups, bowls, vases, lamp shades, bells

outline.description: closed [x, y] outline in local XY (no crossings), pushed out along local Z — signs, gears, keys, shields, panels

rounding.description: round every edge by this radius

bevel.description: 45° chamfer on the front and back rims

taper.description: the front face is this many times the back face (1 = straight)

smooth.description: run a smooth closed curve through the points instead of straight segments

rounding.description: soften the block letters (default a sixth of a stroke)

base.description: solid thickness under the lowest point (default 0.3 × height)

scale.description: feature size of the hills in meters (default a third of the width)

roughness.description: 0 = smooth rolling hills, 1 = broken rocky ground (default 0.4)

points.description: local points of a smooth swept tube — tails, limbs, horns, tentacles

radius.description: one radius, or one per point for tapering

position.description: relative to parent; with attach it is an extra world offset

scale.description: uniform or per local axis; the easy way to stretch a template part

parent.description: position/rotation are relative to this part and follow its rotation (ignored when attach is set)

attach.description: place on another part's surface; the part keeps its own rotation (use align to point it along the surface normal)

to.description: id of the part to attach to

side.description: world direction you look at the target from: top=+Y bottom=-Y front=+Z back=-Z left=+X (the model's left) right=-X; center = its center

offset.description: slide across that side, -1..1 of the target's half size in world axes (top/bottom: [x, z]; front/back: [x, y]; left/right: [z, y])

embed.description: how deep this part sinks in: 0 = just touching, 1 = its center sits on the surface, default 0.35, negative = gap

align.description: rotate this part so its local +Y points along the surface normal (horns, legs, spikes)

op.description: add (default) merges, carve cuts away, intersect keeps only the overlap

only.description: carve/intersect: cut only these parts (and their mirror twins) instead of everything listed before — a window through one wall, a roof clipped to its own box

blend.description: smooth merge radius in meters with everything before it; 0 = hard seam

color.description: #rrggbb, #rgb or a palette key; default a warm clay

preset.description: a named surface: the colour becomes that material, with its grooves and, in textured exports, its relief and shine

kind.description: wood, planks, brick, stone, cobbles, tiles, metal, rust, fabric, leather, grass, bark, marble, sand

scale.description: feature size in meters (a brick, a board, a stone); each kind has a sensible default

accent.description: the second colour (mortar, grout, rust, grain); default derived from the base colour

relief.description: how deep the grooves read: crevice shading, and the normal map in textured exports (default 0.6)

kind.description: spots (Worley cells), stripes, noise blotches, gradient along an axis

color.description: the second color painted by the pattern

scale.description: feature size in meters (spots/stripes/noise); for gradient the height it fades over

amount.description: 0..1 how strongly the pattern color shows (default 1)

axis.description: stripes/gradient direction in the part's local axes; around = vertical staves around local Y. default y

amount.description: surface displacement in meters (rock, bark, lumps)

mirror.description: add a mirrored twin across X (id + ".m")

repeat.description: copies of this part and everything on it: window grids, fence posts, stairs, spokes, columns around a tower (ids id.2, id.3 …)

count.description: how many in all, the part itself included

step.description: world offset from one to the next (meters)

turn.description: degrees each one turns from the last, around `axis` through the centre of `around`

around.description: part whose centre the turn goes around (default the part this one attaches to, else the world origin)

rows.description: a second direction: the whole row repeated this many times (a grid of windows)

scatter.description: spread copies of this part over another part's surface: spikes on a back, rivets, flowers and rocks on terrain, moss on a roof

on.description: the part whose surface the copies are spread over

where.description: up (default): surfaces facing up, like ground or a roof; all: every side

align.description: stand each copy along the surface normal (default true); false keeps them upright

embed.description: how deep each copy sinks in (default 0.35, as in attach)

minGap.description: keep copies at least this far apart (meters)

spin.description: random turn around each copy's own up axis (default true)

separate.description: mesh on its own instead of fusing into the body (wheels, props that spin, held items)

pivot.description: joint location for animation; default: attach point, else top for legs/arms, else center

hidden.description: not meshed; still usable as an anchor or joint

parts.description: in blend order: blend and carve act on the parts listed before them

sculpts.description: applied in order after all parts

kind.description: inflate/dent push out/in, flatten cuts a plane, crease cuts a groove from at to to, noise roughens

at.description: where; required except for a global noise

to.description: id of the part to attach to

offset.description: slide across that side, -1..1 of the target's half size in world axes (top/bottom: [x, z]; front/back: [x, y]; left/right: [z, y])

amount.description: meters: push for inflate/dent/noise, groove depth for crease, how deep flatten cuts

normal.description: flatten plane normal; default: the surface normal at `at`

mirror.description: also apply at the mirrored position across X

clips.description: animations; the rig is built automatically

id.description: clip id, becomes the glTF animation name

type.description: the motion intent; see Clip types

target.description: part to drive for wave/nod/spin/attack (default: auto)

from.description: blend: the clip to fade out of

to.description: blend: the clip to fade into; the blend ends where that clip starts, so play it next

tracks.description: keyframes (type "keyframes") or layered on top of a procedural clip

rotation.description: degrees around the part's pivot, world axes

keys.description: keys sorted by t; eased in and out

secondary.description: springy follow-through on tails, ears and antennas, driven by how the body moves (default true)

preset.description: starting parameters; every other field overrides it

emitter.description: where particles are born: point, sphere, disc (flat, XZ) or box, with a size in meters

blend.description: additive for glowing effects, alpha for smoke and dust

burst.description: emit everything at t=0 instead of continuously

seed.description: change for a different but repeatable variation

at.description: where it sits on the model (preview only)
